meta.prompt: Compare two phone plans side by side. Lite: $25 a month, 10 GB data, 500 minutes of calls, roaming not included, monthly contract, no extras. Max: $45 a month, unlimited data, unlimited calls, roaming in the EU and US, 24-month contract, streaming and 5G included. Mark the better plan on each row (cheaper price, more data, more calls, roaming, shorter contract, more extras). Under the table a recommendation with one sentence that says how many of the six rows the recommended plan wins and how much more it costs per month, and a Choose button under each plan; once I choose, the card says which plan I picked.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Compare phone plans" "Lite vs Max" icon:"sim_card" w:390
  state picked=""
  if picked==""
    ComparisonTable names:["Lite","Max"] prices:["$25/mo","$45/mo"] pick:"Max" pickLabel:"Recommended" cta:"Choose" rows:[["Price","$25","$45",1],["Data","10 GB","Unlimited",2],["Calls","500 min","Unlimited",2],["Roaming","Not included","EU and US",2],["Contract","Monthly","24 months",1],["Extras","None","Streaming and 5G",2]] -> picked=result
    Recommendation "Max" "Max wins 4 of the 6 rows and costs $20 more per month than Lite." reasons:["Unlimited data and calls","Roaming in the EU and US","Streaming and 5G included"] eyebrow:"Recommended"
  if picked!=""
    Receipt "You picked {picked}" "Your {picked} plan is selected." tone:good icon:"check"
